tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current decision is that plain HTTP is not allowed for internal hosts: HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exception, and internal hosts are covered by the certificate management the project already has in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the current decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception for internal hosts, and that the certificate management already in place covers them.

The record has two statements on this, and the later one supersedes the earlier. The earlier one allowed plain HTTP for internal hosts because they sit behind the firewall. The later one requires HTTPS everywhere with no exception. Neither was saved as a formal decision, only as a session excerpt, so I went by which was newer. I left the retired exception out of the file, as you asked.
